abstract: Gastric teratoma is a rare tumor of infancy, almost exclusively found in males. We report a 6-month-old male child with gastric teratoma who presented with gastrointestinal bleeding; he was treated successfully with local excision of the tumor.
abstract_ja: 胃奇形腫は乳児期の稀な腫瘍で、ほぼ男児に限られる。生後6か月の男児が消化管出血で来院した。局所切除術により治療に成功した。
